1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The present petition has been filed seeking quashing of the FIR No.0351/2018 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Geeta Colony.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are present in the Court, however,
the respondent no.2 is not present.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that a settlement was arrived at between the parties before the Delhi Mediation Centre, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi on 30.04.2022 and in terms thereof the divorce This is a digitally signed order.

sentences.text: The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/03/2024 at 01:18:27 was also obtained by the parties and the petitioner no.1 has already paid the full and final settlement amount of Rs.15 lakhs.

5. He further submits that after receiving the entire settlement amount, respondent no.2 is not cooperating and coming forward for the quashing of the aforesaid FIR.
6.
In view of the above, issue notice to the respondent through all permissible modes, returnable on 02.05.2024.
